verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable background automation capability, such as a scheduler, workflow orchestrator, or event-triggered jobs. What it does show are developer building blocks: Cloud APIs for automating workflows, Vertex AI for building agents, and Budget Pub/Sub notifications. It also shows a fixed built-in API hub metadata sync every 6 hours, which is a service behavior rather than an automation the user sets up. These are adjacent at best and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
